name: genome/benchmark
description: Run standard and Continuum-specific benchmarks against a model or adapter. Stores results in BenchmarkResultEntity and embeds in adapter manifest for model card publishing. Supports HumanEval, MBPP, RealClassEval, and collaborative team benchmarks.

params.name: model
params.description: Model path or HuggingFace ID to benchmark. Uses LOCAL_MODELS.DEFAULT if not specified.

params.name: adapter
params.description: Path to LoRA adapter directory to apply on top of base model

params.name: suite
params.description: Comma-separated benchmark suites: humaneval, mbpp, realclasseval, mmlu, collaborative

params.name: teamProjectId
params.description: Team project ID for collaborative benchmark (computes from existing session data)

params.name: academySessionId
params.description: Academy session ID for phenotype benchmark (extracts before/after scores)

params.name: output
params.description: Path to write benchmark results JSON. Default: stdout

params.name: limit
params.description: Max problems to run per suite (for quick testing). Default: all

results.name: suites
results.description: Per-suite results: { humaneval: { score, total, passed, ... }, mbpp: { ... } }
